recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not reintroduce detail.note/detail.description references for FHIR-6215 unless Patient Care later decides to re-add inline planned activity detail or alter the boundary between activity progress notes and the referenced planned activity resource.
issue_request: FHIR-6215 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked whether CarePlan.activity.detail.note should be rolled up into CarePlan.activity.notes, but the final decision instead renamed CarePlan.activity.notes to CarePlan.activity.progress, clarified that progress notes are for adherence/status/progress rather than describing the planned activity, changed the detail note short display, and renamed CarePlan.notes to CarePlan.note.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites SVN #6766. Git-svn commit d6c4981fa8fe7d58cc3e1cc393aa8cc0b6a83c54 is build@6766 and changed the CarePlan spreadsheet from CarePlan.activity.notes to CarePlan.activity.progress, changed its short display and definition, changed CarePlan.activity.detail.note to CarePlan.activity.detail.description with the requested short display, and renamed CarePlan.notes to CarePlan.note. Later source refactors moved the substantive result into source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml.
additional_context: CarePlan is active in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-39101 removed CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail and children from the current model, making the old activity.detail.note/detail.description target obsolete. Later FHIR-48415 re-reviewed CarePlan.activity.progress and updated its comment to refer only to CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityReference, confirming the current post-detail wording. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting FHIR-6215 community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active StructureDefinition already defines CarePlan.activity.progress with the requested status/progress meaning, warns not to use it to describe the activity to be performed, and defines CarePlan.note rather than CarePlan.notes. Searches found no active current-source occurrences of the old CarePlan.activity.notes, CarePlan.activity.detail.note, or CarePlan.notes paths in source/careplan or source/fhir.ini.

related_jiras.note: Removed CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail and its children, making the original FHIR-6215 detail.note/detail.description location obsolete in the current CarePlan model.
Re-reviewed CarePlan.activity.progress and updated the comment to reference CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityReference only.
